Description: Always load scoring data through ScoringService to ensure definitions, overrides, and audit history stay in sync across API and automation flows.
Use the leagueScoringProfile query for UI editors so multipliers include merged defaults, overrides, and grouped values ready for form rendering.
Wrap scoring consumers with LeagueScoringProvider; the hook caches profiles per league and falls back to default settings when data has not loaded yet.
If scoring hooks return errors, verify league membership, reseed default profiles via migrate, and refetch the profile to clear cached failures.
